sharedStateObservations.observation: The compositing descriptor set layout ordering constraint (set 2) is a critical Vulkan pipeline layout invariant — skeleton, compositing, and empty placeholder are mutually exclusive at set 2 to keep light culling at set 3. This knowledge isn't captured in .factory/library/vulkan-descriptor-patterns.md or compositing-shader.md.

summary:
Pass. All 5 assertions (VAL-GFX-001, VAL-GFX-002, VAL-GFX-003, VAL-GFX-007, VAL-GFX-011) are correctly fulfilled.

**VAL-GFX-001**: Rg8Unorm now correctly maps to R8G8_UNORM (format.rs:29). Previously mapped to R8_UNORM which is a single-channel format — a clear bug.

**VAL-GFX-002**: Reverse TryFrom mapping added at format.rs:48 — R8G8_UNORM now maps back to Rg8Unorm.

**VAL-GFX-003**: Both Pipeline (builder.rs) and ComputePipeline (compute_pipeline.rs) now use Option<vk::Pipeline>/Option<vk::PipelineLayout> with take() pattern. destroy() is &mut self, safe to call multiple times. Drop delegates to destroy(). No external callers of destroy() exist, so the signature change is safe. The null-handle fallbacks in vk_pipeline()/vk_layout() are appropriate safety nets.

**VAL-GFX-007**: UIPass::write_with() entirely removed along with its 4 unused parameters and associated imports. No callers remain in the codebase.

**VAL-GFX-011**: MaterialCompiler now places compositing descriptor set layout at set 2 (mutually exclusive with skeleton/empty placeholder) instead of appending after light_culling/shadow. This ensures pipeline layout indices match shader binding points. The conditional structure is clear and the fallback to empty_descriptor_layout when compositing isn't set up is sensible.

Code quality is good: clean diff, proper comments, consistent patterns, no AI slop. 357 tests passing, workspace compiles cleanly.
